pull.title: net, http: handle socket errors separately from reads
pull.body:
On Linux a socket error or hangup is reported whether or not we asked for it. If that happens for a peer we did not request to read from, disconnect directly. This just adds clarity: previously we would attempt a send that would then fail. The only side-effect is a changed log message. Nothing changes on other platforms: since bitcoin/bitcoin#36716 they no longer report errors for established connections.

The last commit does the same for HTTP, where on error it also no longer attempts a final read from a client whose reads are paused.

As a followup to bitcoin/bitcoin#36716, `p2p_socket_errors.py` adds coverage for existing behavior:
- the node ignores a single urgent byte: the connection stays open, ordinary data is still processed and the urgent byte is not counted as received.
- a peer resets the connection while the node's send to it is stalled and receiving from it is paused: the node disconnects without reading anything more (the change above only changes the log message)

Similarly `interface_http.py` checks that:
- a single urgent byte does not disturb an ordinary request.
- a client reset while the server has unsent responses (the HTTP change only changes the log message)

The first commit drops a comment from the `wait_ignores_urgent_data` unit test, as suggested in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36716#discussion_r4700726004.

To support the new tests, the test framework gains:
- `wait_for_send_stall()`, moved out of `p2p_ping_ibd.py`
- a `reset` option for `peer_disconnect()`, which closes the connection with a TCP reset
- `mine_large_block()` returns the block hash and size
- `pack_linger()`, and `linux_host` / `windows_target` to tell which log message to expect

net: disconnect on socket errors before sending

On Linux a socket error or hangup is reported whichever events were
requested. Disconnect directly when no read was requested, skipping
the send attempt that would otherwise fail and disconnect the peer.
This also changes the debug log message.

Co-authored-by: Cory Fields <cory-nospam-@coryfields.com>
